data: Does the accuracy of the teacher's predictions decrease as the number of target domain examples increases?

The graph shows the accuracy of the teacher's predictions on the top n target domain examples with the highest MCD value for the K->D domain pair. The x-axis represents the number of target domain examples, ranging from 0 to 2000. The y-axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 0.75 to 1.00. A single blue line is plotted on the graph, showing a decreasing trend in accuracy as the number of target domain examples increases. The line starts at approximately 1.00 and decreases gradually until it reaches approximately 0.75 at the end of the x-axis. Therefore, the accuracy of the teacher's predictions decreases as the number of target domain examples increases.
